data.title: Wilton Park
data.about:
Wilton Park Residences by Ellington Properties offers a unique living experience that blends contemporary European style with the natural beauty of lush parklands.

Each unit has been perfectly crafted to inspire and enhance your lifestyle, featuring high-quality finishes, intricate textures, and a unique color palette. You will find a range of unit types available, including perfectly crafted studios, 1 & 2 bedroom apartments that offer a serene and tranquil living experience. Being only 12 minutes from Dubai International Airport and conveniently located near the major attractions,  Wilton Park Residences offers the perfect balance between work and play.

location_tile.title: Centrally located for all your needs
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Wilton Park Residence is perfectly located in the heart of Dubai, offering residents quick and easy access to some of the city’s most exciting attractions and amenities. The International Financial Centre is just a short six-minute drive away, making it convenient for business professionals working in the area.

For those who travel frequently, the Dubai International Airport is only a 12-minute drive away, making it easy to catch flights and travel to other destinations. All in all, Wilton Park Residence offers a convenient and comfortable lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most sought-after locations.

  • 01 minutes to City Walk
  • 10 minutes to Jumeirah Beach
  • 15 minutes to Dubai International Airport
  • 15 minutes to Burj Al Arab
  • 15 minutes to La Mer Beach
